explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 91 named tracks/releases across Juno's current techno window, Boomkat's September 14 new-release index, current and official Bandcamp pages, adjacent experimental electronic and dub sources, and targeted persistent-state cross-checks. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. Explicit threat- or panic-coded propositions were deprioritized.
Completed Runs 233, 235, 236, 239 and 240 were compared before ranking. None of the top three proposed boundaries repeats a boundary from those runs.

Every ranked artist/title pair was checked against canonical state, target-local discovery/rejection/PARKED history and the global utility ledger. Previously evaluated or unresolved Sinee remixes, Dyr Dyr, Zikr Atagi, Kool Ranch FM, Perk, Mantequilla (Pariah Remix), Cabo E (Substance Remix), Miniteca Selvática (Pangaea Remix), Destiny, The Soul, Night Time Swim, Recess and prior Coki selections were excluded.

The nine ranked identities are fresh exact-title leads. The two Section 6 leads have a shared release description; all other same-release pairs have differentiated exact-track evidence or explicit evidence limits. No artist, texture, novelty, genre or boundary-diversity quota is applied.
No proposed placement splits Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.
